macro_context.market_sentiment: Risk-off on May 4: Dow -0.98%, S&P 500 and Nasdaq down ~0.5% at midday. UAE intercepted Iranian missiles, jolting markets; WTI crude surged 4% above $106 and Brent +5% above $114. VIX spiked. Markets had been at record highs as recently as May 1 after April's strong rally recovered the S&P 500's prior 9% drawdown.
macro_context.fed_outlook: FOMC held rates at 3.50%-3.75% on April 29, 2026 in a historically rare 8-4 split vote. Committee cited elevated inflation partly from global energy prices. Kevin Warsh moving toward confirmation as next Fed chair after Powell's final meeting; markets pricing no rate changes for remainder of 2026.
macro_context.geopolitical: U.S.-Iran conflict renewed: UAE intercepted Iranian missiles May 4, oil spiking above $106. Strait of Hormuz traffic effectively at standstill. Energy sector +40% YTD is top performer. Secondary risks include U.S. tariff uncertainty, midterm elections, and NATO tensions over Greenland.
key_events: Strait of Hormuz crisis escalating — oil above $106, inflationary pressure on financials
Fed leadership transition: Kevin Warsh likely to take over from Powell shortly
PALANTIR (PLTR) Q1 earnings after close May 4 — AI spending bellwether
Kevin Warsh Senate vote imminent — potential policy pivot risk
U.S. midterm elections later in 2026 adding legislative uncertainty

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Wolfe Research downgraded JPM from Outperform to Peerperform in January 2026, citing slower EPS growth vs. peers on asset sensitivity and higher expense growth. Evercore ISI maintained Outperform with $340 PT on April 17. TD Cowen raised PT to $375 from $370 (Buy). Out of 33 analysts: 14 Buy, 12 Hold, 0 Sell. Consensus Buy with ~20% upside to median PT of $345 from recent price of ~$286.

competitor_activity: Goldman Sachs posted record equities trading revenue in Q1 2026, ceding Apple Card to JPM but competing on prediction markets and IB. Bank of America deepening consumer/wealth cross-sell targeting 16-18% ROTCE. Wells Fargo expanding post-regulatory-cap removal targeting 17-18% ROTCE. JPM now larger than its three biggest rivals combined by market cap. All mega-banks expected to hit record trading fees in 2026, but gap widening versus regionals due to JPM's $10B+ tech budget advantage.
earnings_info: Next earnings: Q2 2026 on July 14, 2026 (before market open). Analyst consensus EPS estimate: $5.39. Most recent (Q1 2026, April 14, 2026): EPS $5.94 vs. $5.49 estimate — beat by +8.2% on stronger-than-expected fixed income and investment banking revenue.
